intro: A busy news day for AI search and shopping: ChatGPT now shows businesses how often it mentions them, TikTok Shop is testing a paid membership, and Google started a ranking update that runs into Black Friday week.

must_reads.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: ChatGPT's new Business Hub (beta) lets companies set up verified profiles and see profile views, mentions and website clicks from ChatGPT. AI chat is turning into a place people find and click through to products, much like Google search. It's another major place links get clicked, and it now has its own stats.

must_reads.title: TikTok Shop launches a paid premium tier for 1M of its top U.S. shoppers
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: TikTok Shop Plus costs about $9.99 a month after a free trial and offers free shipping, discounts and instant refunds, like Amazon Prime. It's a sign TikTok wants shoppers to buy inside its app rather than click out to Amazon or other stores, so there's more tension between platforms over where a purchase happens.

must_reads.title: Google's core update may run until three days before Black Friday
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: Google's November core update started on 10 Nov and could run until 24 Nov, three days before Black Friday. Past updates hit comparison and affiliate-style sites hard. Creators and publishers who rely on search traffic may see big swings in their busiest weeks, and won't be able to tell why until after Cyber Monday.

must_reads.title: IAB Launches Trusted Creator Brand Deal Initiative to Build the Infrastructure Behind the Creator Economy’s Next Phase of Growth
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: The IAB says creator ad budgets will reach about $44B this year, but there is no common way to measure, contract or pay creators. Its survey of 53 industry leaders found 67% name measurement as the top problem. It plans standard definitions (views, impressions, reach) in 2027. Better tracking of which creator drives results is the direction the whole industry is heading.

must_reads.title: Google’s AI Ad Losses Are Meta’s Gain; Chatbot Ad Formats Are Starting To Multiply
must_reads.why: Why it matters for Geniuslink: Advertisers told The Information they are moving money from Google to Meta as Google's AI Mode slows search ad growth. Meanwhile ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Bing and Yahoo Scout are all starting to show ads inside AI answers. Paid placement is arriving in AI answers fast, so where shoppers get sent from them is going to be contested.
